profile.headline: Software Devoloper | Java/Spring Boot Backend Development | AI Tooling & Productivity
profile.summary:
Software engineer with 4+ years building backend systems and platform tooling in Java/Spring Boot. I approach development with a quality-first mindset. Testing isn't something that happens after development, it's integral to building reliable systems. I focus on solving real problems with technology, not just writing code to spec.

I'm actively exploring AI integration and tooling. I've built custom MCP servers to better understand protocol-level integration between AI agents and systems, championed Amazon Q adoption on my team, and experiment with agentic AI systems in my personal projects. I believe the developers who understand how to leverage AI effectively will have a significant advantage in the coming years.

My path to software development wasn't traditional. I worked as a paralegal before earning my CS degree in 2021. That background gave me something valuable: I understand both the technology AND the people using it. I've seen terrible software make people's jobs harder, and I'm committed to building systems that actually solve problems instead of creating new ones.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Backend Development (March 2025 - Present)

▪ Backend development on Java/Spring Boot microservices consuming Kafka events
▪ Led technical debt initiatives including Gradle 9 migrations and security vulnerability remediation
▪ Contributed to API feature development while navigating team transitions
▪ Championed AI-assisted development practices using Amazon Q, driving adoption across the team

Platform Engineering & Automation (Nov 2022 - March 2025)

▪ Designed and maintained Java/Spring-based automation frameworks and integration testing infrastructure used accross mutiple scrum teams
▪ Built and configured Jenkins CI/CD pipelines integrating automated validation into enterprise delivery workflows
▪ Developed reusable testing utilities and data validation tools improving reliability and release confidence
▪ Created SQL-based data transformation and validation logic supporting integration testing and analytics verification
▪ Led quality engineering initiatives for a scrum team while maintaining hands-on development of shared tooling
▪ Authored technical documentation including architecture diagrams, integration guides, and operational runbooks

positions.title: Software Developer and Quality Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Developed and maintained Java/Spring-based automation frameworks for integration testing across multiple scrum teams
▪ Built Jenkins CI/CD pipelines and automation infrastructure
▪ Created reusable testing utilities and SQL-based data validation tools
▪ Led quality engineering efforts while developing shared platform tooling
▪ Collaborated with architects and developers on technical strategy and system design

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Automation testing using Java and Selenium
▪ Creating SQL scripts used for Database/ETL testing
▪ Using Postman to test APIs
▪ Manual testing of web applications to ensure technical, functional, and business requirements are met.
▪ Writing scripts using Postman to automate API testing
▪ Reviewing and signing-off on test plans written by junior QA Engineers and interns
▪ Identifying, recording, tracking, and reporting of bugs and other areas of risk to stakeholders
▪ Communicating directly with business client to assist with UAT and defect triage

positions.title: Managing Paralegal
positions.description:
▪ Assisted attorneys by managing multiple high-volume real estate trust accounts to ensure compliance with state bar and RESPA regulations
▪ Fraud prevention, monthly 3-way reconciliation, daily monitoring of accounts, risk analysis, and quality assurance. 
▪ Reviewed legal documents for quality assurance and to ensure that all regulatory compliance laws and best practices were met. 
▪ Created custom reports for the executive team using financial and real estate transactional data to assist with legal and business processes 
▪ Reporting to the IRS for real estate sales, backup bookkeeping using QuickBooks for the business operations, and disbursing funds for real estate transactions
